TITLE: Work Orders List – Lead Technician Shows the Sign-In Account Name, Not the Staff Record Name
TYPE: Story Defect · PARENT: SV-10048 (Choose what is shown — Fields to display and columns; Ready for QA, read live 16 Oct 2026 — re-read before the ask) · PRIORITY: Medium · LINK: relates to SV-10048
ALREADY REPORTED: none found among SV-11101, SV-11310, SV-11317 to SV-11326, SV-11338, SV-11393 to SV-11398 (titles read live 16 Oct 2026).
SEEN ON: staging build {{v26.40.18-7d85b7d}}, 16 Oct 2026 (run 498, C581895; first noticed the same morning in C96929's List picture).
STATUS: DRAFT — NOT FILED. One ask per ticket; the QA lead decides (Rule 62/113).
OPEN POINT FOR THE QA LEAD: List is described as "unchanged" by this release; production was NOT checked, so this may be List's existing behaviour. The PRD (S5-R11b) assumes List shows the staff record name. Decide whether this is a List defect, a Tech View/Board View question for the product owner, or neither.

h2. Description

*Every name for a technician should be the technician's staff record name, the same name in List, Tech View and Board View.* On staging, for Carol Neal (staff record name in Settings > Staff), List's Lead Technician column shows "David Sparks", while Tech View and Board View show "Carol Neal".

For example,
* Settings > Staff lists "Carol Neal"; no staff member is called David Sparks
* List's Lead Technician for her work orders reads "David Sparks"
* Board View's column, card and avatar hover, and Tech View's group header and avatar hover, read "Carol Neal"

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Sign in to staging as an Admin and check the top bar shows *Staging Heavy Duty - 9919*.
# Click your initials > *Settings* > *Staff*, click *Search* and type {{Carol}}.
#* The staff record reads Carol Neal.
# Open *Work Orders*, click the *All* tab, click *List* and type {{ZZAUTOTEST Staff Names 10160936}} in *Search* (work order S2-36397, led by Carol Neal).
#* Lead Technician reads "David Sparks".
# Click *Board View*, then *Tech View*.
#* The column header, card lead, group header and avatar hover names read "Carol Neal".

*Actual Result:*
* List: "David Sparks". Tech View and Board View: "Carol Neal".

*Expected Result:*
* As the test expects: *"Step 5: List's Lead Technician shows {Technician-A}'s staff record name, as written down at step 2."* and *"Steps 5 to 12: no other name for either technician appears anywhere (for example not ZZAUTOTEST Account Ana)."*
